in_sanskrit.name: Sahidur
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Victory
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sahidur एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who achieves victory through the grace of the God of Gods, Lord Vishnu. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sahi' meaning victory and 'Dur' meaning Lord.

in_hindi.name: Sahidur
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Victory
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sahidur एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who achieves victory through the grace of the God of Gods, Lord Vishnu. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sahi' meaning victory and 'Dur' meaning Lord.

in_tamil.name: Sahidur
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் God of Victory
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sahidur ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who achieves victory through the grace of the God of Gods, Lord Vishnu. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sahi' meaning victory and 'Dur' meaning Lord.

in_telugu.name: Sahidur
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే God of Victory
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sahidur ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who achieves victory through the grace of the God of Gods, Lord Vishnu. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sahi' meaning victory and 'Dur' meaning Lord.

in_marathi.name: Sahidur
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sahidur हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who achieves victory through the grace of the God of Gods, Lord Vishnu. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sahi' meaning victory and 'Dur' meaning Lord.

in_bengali.name: Sahidur
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Victory
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sahidur একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who achieves victory through the grace of the God of Gods, Lord Vishnu. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sahi' meaning victory and 'Dur' meaning Lord.
